title: Mash
summary: MASH, noun [Latin mastico.] 1. A mixture or mass of ingredients, beaten or blended together in a promiscuous manner. 2. A mixture for a horse. 3. A mesh. [See Mesh, the more common orthography.] MASH,

inlines.v: MASH, noun [Latin mastico.] 1. A mixture or mass of ingredients, beaten or blended together in a promiscuous manner. 2. A mixture for a horse. 3. A mesh. [See Mesh, the more common orthography.] MASH, verb transitive To beat into a confused mass. 1. To bruise; to crush by beating or pressure; as, to mash apples in a mill. 2. To mix malt and water together in brewing.
